description: This PHP test class `PimDefinedReportDaoTest` verifies the functionality of report data access object (DAO) operations within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It includes setup methods, test cases for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting PIM-defined reports, and utilizes external dependencies such as entity classes and DAOs.

classes.name: PimDefinedReportDaoTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying report DAO operations in OrangeHRM’s PIM plugin, including fetching, saving, updating, and deleting report records.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initializes test data before any test methods run by populating necessary fixtures.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the necessary environment before each test, including initializing DAO instances and populating fixture data.

methods.name: testGetPimDefinedReportList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a list of PIM-defined reports, asserting the count and type.

methods.name: testDeletePimDefinedReportList
methods.description: Tests deletion of specified reports and verifies the deletion count.

methods.name: testGetPimDefinedReportById
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a specific report by ID, checking its properties.

methods.name: testSavePimDefinedReport
methods.description: Tests creation and saving of a new PIM-defined report with associated filters and fields.

methods.name: testUpdatePimDefinedReport
methods.description: Verifies updating an existing report and associated filters.
